title: Importance-Aware Feature Sparsification for Wireless Split Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wireless split learning (SL) reduces on-device computation by offloading upper layers to a server, yet transmitting high-dimensional intermediate features at each iteration remains a major communication bottleneck. Existing methods select features at the client side using task-agnostic criteria such as magnitude, statistics, or clustering, which increases client-side processing and often degrades accuracy under non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) client data. We propose importance-aware class-balanced sparsification (ICS), a lightweight approach in which the server ranks feature channels using Grad-CAM-based scores obtained from the true-class logit during backpropagation. translated_title: 面向无线拆分学习的重要性感知特征稀疏化
translated_abstract: 无线拆分学习（SL）通过将上层网络卸载到服务器来减少设备端的计算量，但在每次迭代中传输高维中间特征仍然是一个主要的通信瓶颈。现有方法在客户端使用与任务无关的准则（如幅值、统计量或聚类）来选择特征，这增加了客户端的处理负担，并且在非独立同分布的客户端数据下常常导致精度下降。我们提出重要性感知的类别均衡稀疏化，这是一种轻量级方法，由服务器在反向传播过程中利用基于Grad-CAM的分数（从真实类别的logit获得）对特征通道进行排序。各类别的分数被聚合为一个类别均衡、与标签无关的重要性向量，以缓解标签偏斜下的头部类别偏差，每个客户端在下一轮中复用该向量来保留前N个特征通道，且不产生额外的开销。
tldr: 提出重要性感知的类别均衡稀疏化方法（ICS），由服务器利用基于Grad-CAM的分数对特征通道排序并生成类别均衡的重要性向量，客户端复用该向量保留最重要的特征通道，从而在降低无线拆分学习通信开销的同时缓解标签偏斜带来的精度下降。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes importance-aware class-balanced sparsification (ICS), where the server ranks feature channels via Grad-CAM-based scores to build a class-balanced importance vector that clients reuse to retain the top-N channels, reducing communication overhead in wireless split learning while mitigating accuracy degradation under label skew.
